title: Russia's offensive ability is broken, Kyiv's former top general tells BBC
snippet: In his first interview since being forced from his post, Gen Syrskyi speaks about Ukraine's future in the war.

title: Horrified witnesses recount fatal rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
snippet: One person is dead and others were injured after an incident at the amusement park in the US state of Georgia.

title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
snippet: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series.

title: Watch: Emergency calls from botched Christa Pike execution released
snippet: A series of calls, obtained by the Associated Press, reveal emergency services were delayed in reaching Pike.

title: Bulgaria summons Russian ambassador after ship sinks in Black Sea drone attack
snippet: Six crew members are rescued but 10 are missing after a merchant ship was sunk overnight, Bulgaria says.

title: Pope admitted to hospital for surgery to remove lump on his lung
snippet: Pope Leo has said the growth is "contained" and had been found "at a very early stage".

title: BBC FM radio transmissions suspended in Afghanistan
snippet: BBC programming is still reaching audiences on shortwave, medium wave, via satellite and online.

title: Hungarian MPs scrap Orbán's anti-LGBTQ measures
snippet: LGBTQ and human rights activists warmly welcomed the move, but call for changes to other Orbán-era laws.

title: Super El Niño sets another record as it strengthens to 'unprecedented levels'
snippet: El Niño has continued to strengthen, with several key measures now in record territory. Simon King explores how it compares to previous events.

title: Ex-president named leader of new DR Congo rebel coalition
snippet: Joseph Kabila had previously denied having links to the M23 rebels, which control much of eastern DR Congo.

title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
snippet: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

title: India 'cockroach' leaders detained after entering barricaded protest site
snippet: Protesters climbed over barricades in central Delhi to demand the election chief resign over revised voter lists.

title: Watch: US man eyes pumpkin world record after fifth contest win
snippet: Horticulture teacher Travis Gienger hauled his pumpkin from Minnesota to Half Moon Bay, California where he won the annual event.

title: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
snippet: Shadrack Sibiya had denied grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old.

title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
snippet: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

title: Immigration agents search congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
snippet: Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, said the search was "an attempt to target political enemies" and she "will not be silenced".

title: Is Zelensky right to say data centre strikes have taken down Russian bots?
snippet: Experts say there is no evidence that Russian trolls have been affected by Ukraine’s Yandex attacks.

title: The island where locals say data centres are taking their water
snippet: "Not a single drop has come through our taps for the last three months," a local tells the BBC.

title: Boardroom feud tests trusted Indian business empire
snippet: The dispute raises questions about the Indian conglomerate's governance, succession plans and future.

title: Death threats and isolation - the cost of fighting sexual violence in Iraq
snippet: Women say they share stories of abuse to highlight the issue, despite social pressure and safety fears.

title: Where the US midterm elections will be won and lost
snippet: An in-depth look at the key polling, races and issues ahead of an election that will define Trump’s final two years as president.

title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
snippet: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.

title: What could Trump's energy ceasefire mean for Ukraine?
snippet: The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv, where Ukrainians face another winter with electricity outages.

title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
snippet: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.

title: Watch: Endangered orangutans released back into the wild after Borneo fires
snippet: The critically endangered apes were rescued from intense wildfires that destroyed their habitat in August and September.
